listitem.para: Real or complex-valued input vector or matrix.
(optional) Dimension along which to compute the maximum-to-minimum difference.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `peak2peak` function computes the difference between the maximum and minimum values in `X`. By default, it operates along the first non-singleton dimension of `X`. If the `dim` parameter is provided, the computation is performed along the specified dimension.
